headline: Petroecuador Dismantles 200th Gas Flare in Environmental Phase-Out Program
summary: State oil company Petroecuador shut down its 30th gas flare unit of the year, taking the total number of dismantled structures to 200 as part of its plan to capture and utilize associated gas.
why: Eliminating gas flaring reduces carbon intensity for state energy producers and allows natural gas to be captured for domestic power generation.
